info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery ETA Retrieval API provides real-time estimated time of arrival (ETA) information for food delivery orders within the specified service area. This endpoint allows applications to access ETA data for ongoing deliveries, ensuring that customers and businesses can effectively manage expectations regarding delivery times. Typical consumers of this API include food delivery services, restaurant management systems, and logistics platforms looking to enhance operational efficiency. Integrating this API supports businesses in improving customer satisfaction through timely updates.

get.summary: Retrieve the estimated delivery time for a given order.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the estimated delivery time for an order based on the provided parameters. It takes into consideration the current location, delivery options, and any potential delays that may affect the estimated arrival. Use this to get real-time updates on your delivery schedule.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to obtain the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for deliveries. It should include relevant parameters that the server will use to calculate the ETA.
